context_requirements: Active polyol pathway flux or high aldose reductase (AKR1B1) expression
An inflammatory or oxidative stimulus that AR mediates (e.g., LPS, bleomycin, high glucose)
TGF-beta-driven fibroblast or mesenchymal activation for the fibrosis-related arm
Tumor cells with AR-dependent survival signaling for the anticancer arm
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed late genes at 24 h in any line
Strong, broad transcriptional response at 6 h inconsistent with the slow kinetics expected
Selective and reproducible downregulation of AKR1B1-dependent inflammatory genes across all lines
Absence of any line-dependent difference despite known differences in AKR1B1 expression

evidence.supports: ARI-809, a selective aldose reductase inhibitor, prevents/reverses diabetic retinopathy in rats, supporting AR as a pathogenic mediator in vivo.
Fidarestat counteracts diabetes-associated cataract, retinal oxidative-nitrosative stress, glial activation, and apoptosis, indicating AR inhibition reduces oxidative and apoptotic programs.
Fidarestat ameliorates LPS-induced acute kidney injury and reduces cytokine mRNA expression, linking AR inhibition to suppression of inflammatory gene transcription.
Epalrestat, an aldose reductase inhibitor, shows anticancer synergy, supporting AR dependence in cancer progression.
Epalrestat ameliorates bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis and reverses TGF-beta1, alpha-SMA, and collagen I upregulation, supporting a fibrosis-related transcriptional arm.

changes: Removed TGFB3, COL1A1, COL4A1, MMP2, SERPINE1, and TIMP2 from late_up: the cited fibrosis evidence shows epalrestat reverses TGF-beta1, alpha-SMA, and collagen I upregulation, so these genes should be down, not up, under AR inhibition.

Removed PTGS2, CXCL2, IL1B, CCL2, ICAM1, NFKBIA, and TNFRSF21 from late_down: the cited inflammation evidence supports suppression of cytokine transcription, but these specific genes are not directly supported by the abstracts and some are generic inflammatory/stress genes.
Kept proximal_up and proximal_down empty because aldose reductase inhibition has no known direct transcriptional immediate-target genes in this landmark set.
Kept generic_effects as oxidative_stress and apoptosis, supported by the fidarestat retinal oxidative-nitrosative stress and apoptosis abstract.
Kept kinetics slow and magnitude weak/none because the cited in vivo effects require weeks to months and no direct 6 h or 24 h transcriptional data are provided.
Kept line_response mostly weak/none because the abstracts do not provide cell-line-specific transcriptional responses for these nine lines.
